Choose the chat type based on your use case:

buttonAction.intro:
• Download: The button downloads the file referenced by the URL. The URL must point to a file in Firebase Storage.
  • Navigate: The button navigates to the given URL. The URL must be an internal route (see the MenuItem configuration).
  • Browse: The button links to an external URL (https://domain.com/path).
  • Zoom: The file referenced by the URL is shown in a zoom viewer (typically an image). The URL must point to a file in Firebase Storage.
  • None: No action is performed. The URL is ignored. This is the default setting.
